hook: Moisant built his career on the operational spine of technology organizations, infrastructure, security, enterprise platforms, and the internal systems that keep large companies running. At Indeed, overseeing 300 million monthly visitors and three million employers, he sits at the intersection of consumer scale and enterprise risk, leading both the CIO and CSO functions simultaneously.
name: Anthony Moisant

quote.text: Transforming Business and Protecting Data with Expertise in Cybersecurity and Digital Innovation.

timeline.event: Serves as a nuclear submarine sailor in the U.S. Navy
timeline.impact: Builds technical foundation in infrastructure, security, and systems development

timeline.event: Progresses from junior consultant to director at Versata
timeline.impact: Gains enterprise application, infrastructure, and security operations experience

timeline.event: Holds IT leadership roles at Sony Gracenote and Tribune Media
timeline.impact: Deepens enterprise IT leadership across media and technology sectors
Builds and scales enterprise security, privacy, and IT across a major HR platform

timeline.event: Group VP then CIO/CSO at Indeed; Executive Officer at Recruit Holdings
timeline.impact: Leads technology and security at global scale across the HR Tech portfolio

quick_facts: SVP, Chief Information Officer and Chief Security Officer at Indeed
Executive Officer at Recruit Holdings, supporting security and technology strategy across the global HR Tech portfolio including Indeed and Glassdoor
Previously SVP, CIO and CSO at Glassdoor for nearly six years
Veteran of the U.S. Navy, where he served as a nuclear submarine sailor and held technical roles in C++ and infrastructure security
CISSP-certified; serves on the Sierra Ventures CXO Advisory Board

achievements.title: SVP, CIO and CSO, Indeed
achievements.impact: Leads information technology and security strategy for one of the world's largest job-matching platforms, serving 300M+ unique monthly visitors and 3M employers.

achievements.title: SVP, CIO and CSO, Glassdoor
achievements.impact: Held global leadership over IT, Security, Privacy, Compliance, Enterprise Applications, Legal, Risk, Real Estate, and Workplace Operations across nearly six years.

achievements.title: SBU Executive Officer, Recruit Holdings
achievements.impact: Supports security and technology strategy across the full global HR Tech portfolio, including Indeed, Glassdoor, Flex, and Indeed Recruit.

achievements.title: U.S. Navy nuclear submarine service
